title: Pick Place Drawer To Counter
instruction: Pick the dish brush from the drawer and place it on the counter.

title: Open Blender Lid
instruction: Open the blender by taking off the lid and placing it on the counter.

title: Prepare Coffee
instruction: Pick the mug from the cabinet, place it under the coffee machine dispenser, and press the start button.

title: Bread And Cheese
instruction: Place the bread and cheese on the cutting board.

title: Veggie Dip Prep
instruction: Place the two vegetables and bowl onto the tray for setting up a vegetable dip station.
